column3: With respect to the MRN Portfolio Mortgage Loan (5.5%), Red Steakhouse, the sole tenant at the 413 Prospect Mortgage Property, has a right of first refusal to purchase the 413 Prospect Mortgaged Property pursuant to the terms of its lease if the borrower receives an offer for the sale of the 413 Prospect Mortgaged Property that the borrower intends to accept. Upon receipt of notice from the borrower of such third-party offer, Red Steakhouse will have 5 days to exercise its right of first refusal to purchase the 413 Prospect Mortgage Property at the price and on the terms of such third-party offer.
